vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-71556
vulnerability.description: go-git: Arbitrary file read/write via symbolic link resolution.

statements.impact_statement: Eventrouter does not depend on go-git: the package appears in neither go.mod nor go.sum, and eventrouter performs no Git operations. Scanner matches occur via keyword matching on 'git' keywords in image metadata, not a dependency relationship. Because the component is absent, eventrouter is not affected by any CVE in github.com/go-git/go-git; CVE-2026-71556 is the known instance of this pattern (flagged against the sibling cluster-logging operator image, LOG-10083/LOG-10084/LOG-10085), recorded here as the representative case. Confirmed absent from the manifests both before and after PR #69.
